description: Pre-send batch check for up to 10 payees ($0.03): returns one signed PaySafe verdict per recipient (poisoning lookalike, USDC blacklist, OFAC). Not a permission to pay. $0.03 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

items.description: JSON array of objects or strings, e.g. [{"payee":"0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000","chain":"arc"}]

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
